{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend trench coat, straight cut, knee-length, slate grey with hex code #708090, waterproof fabric.
Relaxed-fit knit top, crew neck, hip-length, cream white with hex code #FFFDD0, soft merino wool.
Tailored wool trousers, tapered leg, ankle-length, charcoal with hex code #36454F, heavy twill.
Leather Chelsea boots, sleek silhouette, mid-calf height, dark brown with hex code #5C4033, water-resistant leather.

This outfit balances the practical needs of walking to work in autumn rain with a polished look for the office. The trench coat provides essential protection against possible precipitation while maintaining a sleek silhouette that doesn't bulk up under layers. Choosing tailored trousers and a refined knit ensures you look neat and professional despite the casual movement, while the dark color palette remains classic and appropriate for a business setting."}
